kb.a: Oreka is an $8,555 closed deal already in production. Laura owns customer communication. It is a production follow-through item, not a new-sales chase.

Pure Good is roughly a $329,000 opportunity tied to the same Kenna meeting gate. It advances when the Kenna follow-up is resolved and a next commercial step is scheduled. Do not present it as closed or production-ready.

A Spanish-speaking website lead wants 100 units of a 1.7-ounce custom cream with retinol, hyaluronic acid, collagen, and niacinamide. Sam already replied, and the open loop is a price. Provide pricing to close the conversation without overstating a commitment.

Nikkie is actively working Curly 911/Victoria's 500-unit opportunity and Rachel Trautwein's men's haircare launch for shampoo and conditioner. The Curly 911 call invite needs the time conflict checked, while Rachel still needs qualification on size and project details.

The Production Pipeline CRM build is approved and queued for execution. It should be executed only when Sam says go. The CRM session is currently logged out, so live verification remains blocked until Sam restores it.

WhatsApp and the CRM are both logged out today. Restoring WhatsApp unblocks the client sweep and Terra Lotus follow-up; restoring CRM access unblocks fix verification and operational lookup. Neither session should be described as connected until reauthenticated.

Ronald supplies formula and BOM cost inputs where needed. His costing work must include the requested inputs before any quote is issued, and no quote should rely on a BOM alone. There is no new Ronald completion recorded in this refresh.

Tesfa Shiferaw at Bahrzaf has an active shampoo-and-conditioner project; the previously scheduled Monday conversation has no recorded outcome in this refresh. Keep the project in follow-up rather than claiming a completed meeting.
Ashley Harmon at Apothik wants a call today at 2:30 or 3 PM Eastern, or Monday. Sam should pick a slot; the Consultant will book it, and it should not be described as booked before that choice.

Tasnim Broud at AYYUR is considering a ritual-oil package with a 30 mL frosted glass bottle and gold dropper/cap. She is open to PLL sourcing and has not selected a vendor. The commercial path is to move toward prototype quantities once packaging direction is confirmed.

Nabil Saleh at CN1 Fragrance is interested in 4,000-plus eight-ounce tubes of scented body lotion using his own fragrance oil. The next qualification points are formula, tube packaging, and timing. No new response is recorded in this refresh.

Max at Delphos House previously proposed an August 18 launch-strategy call, but it was not confirmed and no outcome is recorded here. Aidan's raw-materials answer remains a separate Delphos follow-up.

Dan Hunter at Hunter Amenities wants to meet next Wednesday after inbound interest through James Pitenis. The retail and airline-amenities channel could bring real volume, but units are not qualified yet.
No CRM Developer replies arrived overnight. There is no new developer status to read back, so keep the CRM fix state unchanged until a reply is received and verified.
Delizioso Skincare's NDA is confirmed. The relationship is moving forward; no additional delivery or timing detail is recorded in this refresh.
An overnight Huntington alert showed a $10,000 item plus a $5,000 ACH/withdrawal. It is flagged to Sam for confirmation and is likely normal supplier or payroll activity, but it remains unconfirmed.

Lisa Christensen’s order 1467 still shows not shipped after 10-plus days, although she received an on-its-way email. The live status needs checking and Laura owns an honest customer reply today; shipment is not confirmed from the email alone.

The Geo Twin, PLL-Search-ContractMfg-2026 #2, was re-enabled and spent $10.12 on August 23 after zero spend August 20–22. Sam must decide whether to pause it or keep it in the Manual-CPC plan; the main campaigns remain on Maximize Conversions pending approval.

The ConvertFlow two-branch fork and Shopify floating Call/Book widget are staged on drafts, with the live site untouched. Sam must approve the R&D button wording and contact-form fields. Then the branching can be built and screens shown before any swap.
An unrecognized Geo ad campaign appeared in last night's Ads report. Sam must confirm whether it was authorized; if not, it should be paused. No authorization or pause is recorded yet.

Victor Armendarez is pursuing 2,000 units each of Curl Cream and Edge Gel. Pricing is overdue because packaging compatibility and Ronald's full cost inputs still need confirmation; do not issue a quote until those inputs are complete.
Ethnic Gals is a real 2,000-unit opportunity that has not yet been quoted. Build it in the unquoted-brand cleanup lane once the warm Talova and approved-send priorities are cleared.

Sam’s Sept 1 lane is to protect the 2pm Tammye Hall call, resolve the urgent Morning Glory label review, review Mark Higgins’s ingredient brief, and provide direction on Gridlot’s NDA and Studio S5’s questions. Enso’s 9:15am proposal is not confirmed by Sam; Payroll is on the calendar at 11am ET. No new day-update entry was available.

Aidan is driving Atlas Eternal’s $26,500 production across four lanes, with $13,250 due on completion, and is coordinating Terra Lotus’s 19,000-unit sample checkpoint. He should support Mark Higgins’s formulation review and confirm the three Terra sample sets shipped; neither Terra shipment nor any new completion is verified here.

Talova Labs’ Marcello remains a warm reorder lane for Coco Vanilla. Before Sam locks the PO, PLL still needs a clean confirmation that Kenna’s small revisions were received; that confirmation is not present in today’s sources.

Terra Lotus has 19,000 units in R&D at a sample-shipment checkpoint: Shampoo 5K, Body Wash 9K, and Conditioner 5K. The current sources do not confirm shipment, so Aidan/Ronald must verify all three sets before the next commercial step.

Mark Higgins supplied the requested ingredient brief for two aluminum-free roll-on deodorant SKUs. It is ready for Sam and formulation-team review before pricing; a chemist-call time with Ron and Evelyn still needs to be selected and confirmed.

Tammye Hall is booked for Tuesday, September 1 from 2:00–2:30pm ET with Google Meet link https://meet.google.com/ohj-dbga-fej. She previously missed a meeting because she expected a phone call, so confirm the format and agenda explicitly before this manufacturing-and-fulfillment discussion.

James Bailey at 1 Of Us Holdings/Morning Glory requested urgent pre-print review of shampoo-label corrections while production is reportedly underway. Verify whether labels have printed, then route the full regulatory/artwork checklist; no client response or commitment is recorded from this refresh.

Yianni Koutsos at Gridlot Partners says the previously sent NDA appears to belong to another project and needs a clean beef-tallow NDA. The approved PLL_NDA_Template.docx is still missing from the sending library; do not send a document until the correct template is verified, and keep Seb copied.

AF Brand is on the calendar for Wednesday, September 2 from 3:00–4:00pm ET with James and Laura listed; Sam is marked declined and the organizer is declined. Resolve ownership and attendance before treating this as a live Sam meeting.

Cameron Nelligan’s Sunkissd discovery call was scheduled for August 31 at 6:00pm ET about a tallow-based lip balm and a 10,000-unit first order. Otter shared a recording notification, but no verified outcome or next commercial step is present in today’s sources.

David Aminov of Made Man Barber/MANORE discussed beef tallow balm, packaging, and pricing at 1,000, 2,500, and 5,000 units in 2-ounce jars. The August 31 call had a Google Meet link, but no verified outcome or attribution is recorded in this refresh.

Ari Levitin of Click Industries/DEWPAD had a chemist call scheduled August 31 to review custom formula pricing at 5,000, 10,000, 20,000, and 40,000 units, with a stated $3.50 target at 10,000. No verified call outcome or technical/commercial commitment is recorded here.

Mark Cafolla remains an active custom-peptide opportunity with NDA executed and packaging/sample specifications in progress. The old August 28 call record is historical; no September 1 call or newly verified outcome is present in today’s sources.
